mutants.expected_detection: SR1 check fails because fifo_wr_ptr, a required control_state register, is misclassified as data_pipeline with tmr_recommended=false, so not all 5 control_state registers are correctly identified and flagged tmr_recommended=true.
SR2 check counts data_pipeline entries with tmr_recommended=true; this mutant sets mac_acc_reg and data_stage1_reg both to true (2 of 3, exceeding the allowed max of 1), so it must fail SR2.

SR3 keyword/heuristic check over justification fields of the 5 control_state entries should fail because fewer than 3 of 5 contain silent-corruption rationale terms (state, control flow, address, silent) — the justifications are replaced with generic boilerplate text lacking these terms.

evaluate.py cross-references the 'registers' array against all reg/flip-flop signals declared in controller_datapath.v (per register_map.json) and fails FR1 because 'data_stage2_reg' is omitted entirely from the submission, violating the no-omissions requirement even though summary counts were adjusted to match the truncated array.

FR2 requires bit_width to be an integer matching the RTL declaration; this mutant changes ctrl_state's bit_width to a string literal "4" instead of the integer 4, and also flips tmr_recommended for mode_reg to the string "true" instead of a JSON boolean, violating the required field types in FR2 (bit_width: integer, tmr_recommended: boolean).
